method: Closest report-sized parent plus a whole-parent implementation allowance, applied to area, active dynamic, clock-only idle and leakage before the existing node conversion
allowance_basis: 25% is an explicit engineering reserve for changed single-child control and the 163rd neural input, not measured overhead. Applying it to whole parents also reserves capacity for registers, control and local wiring without separately adding already SRAM-priced per-node state.
sensitivity_status: Uncalibrated scenarios, not confidence intervals or guaranteed lower/upper bounds

owners.u_sel: Retained cache buffers, CAM interface and UCB handshake; remaining-action tests and linked-list walk change control
owners.u_upd: Retained seeded remainder, Q17 codec, board/path buffers and backprop; one-child allocation, action-mask scan and tail linking change control
owners.top_level_glue: Retained phase handshakes and shared-memory arbitration; four-cycle finish and capacity checks change control
owners.u_nn: Closest 162-input by 96-hidden report for the 163-input Go model; digital accumulation, precision and shared readout geometry unchanged; no exact parameter report

excluded: Host Go legality/history, I/O, weight programming and physical signoff remain outside the cost claim; no new synthesized controller or delay result
